title: Beyond Halloween: Poland Keeps Ancient Dziady Tradition Of Honouring Ancestral Spirits Alive
description: During the celebration, participants lit torches, gathered around bonfires, performed ritual chants and symbolically offered food and drinks to the spirits of the dead because it is believed that the souls of their ancestors could return to the world of the living during this time, while fire warmed the spirits and symbolically helped guide them home.

title: Africa: Australia's Exported Fossil Fuels Emit More Than 44 'Least Developed Countries' Combined
description: [Global Witness] COP31 co-host Australia's fossil fuel exports produced more emissions than the combined 44 "least developed countries" in the 10 years since the Paris Agreement, a new Global Witness analysis of Australian government data can reveal

title: Cleopatra’s eye makeup secret? Ancient Egyptians used lead-based kohl
description: In ancient Egypt, kohl was more than just a cosmetic; it served dual purposes, enhancing beauty while protecting the eyes. Studies indicate that its ingredients could boost immune responses, making it a valuable tool for health. Both men and women embraced the use of black and green powders, and ancient texts highlight the fusion of cosmetics with medicine, revealing the intricate beliefs surrounding beauty and wellness in that era.
